answer: In this PoA design, each validator’s reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity and consensus thresholds therefore prevent them from amplifying one another, whether posing as shale, harbor, or quill.
